errors.not_paired: Add this blind again so Homey can learn your remote.

pair.title: Add shading
pair.listening: Press a button on your remote
pair.listening_hint: Hold the Bear remote near Homey and press UP, STOP or DOWN on any channel, so Homey can learn which remote your blinds and awnings belong to.
pair.timeout: Homey didn't hear a press from a Bear remote. Move the remote closer to Homey and try again.
pair.found_hint: Next, pick the channels you actually use. Once they are added, calibrate each one: open it in Homey and choose Settings → Maintenance → Try to Repair. Until a blind has been timed, Homey can send it up and down but cannot hold it at a position.
pair.not_learned: Homey hasn't learned your remote yet. Go back and press a button on the remote.

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.intro_hint: Homey has no way to see where the blind is; it can only time it. So this runs the blind from end to end: first fully closed, then fully open, then fully closed again. Tap the button the moment it reaches each end. Stay where you can watch it.
calibrate.prepare_hint: Running it all the way down, so the timing starts from an end Homey knows. Tap once it has stopped.
calibrate.opening_hint: Tap the moment the blind reaches the top and stops.
calibrate.closing_hint: Tap the moment the blind reaches the bottom and stops.
calibrate.done_hint: Homey has this blind's travel times, and knows it is fully closed right now.
calibrate.too_short: That run was under a second. Start again, and tap only once the blind has actually reached the end.
